changelog:
- Initial release of libtv-api-skills.
- Enables generation and editing of AI images and videos via LibLib.tv.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, animation, and custom drawing/video features.
- Includes CLI usage guide and key API endpoints.
- Provides instructions for authentication and downloading results.
